body:

[QantasCollector] The promo code MCMH26 is not applicable to your selected flights. Please check the promo terms or select different travel dates.
[TheMills] Basically, offer applies only to the flights that you dont need! 🫠
[jaygriz] Not true - India, Bangladesh, Saudi Arabia.
[illumination] This guy thinks Qantas only flies to and within Australia
[bchliu] Indian Ocean outside of Perth apparently
[Skyisblue] • Booking Period: Through December 31, 2026
• Travel Period: Through March 4, 2027
[dinglejerry] Flew with them recently to the maldives for a surf trip. Service was good enough. Seats in economy ok on the Sydney - KL leg (but not great). On the KL-Male leg had the 737-MAX, horrible seats to get any rest, very uncomfortable. Surfboards arrived intact.
Probably 4/10 for comfort, 7/10 service, so maybe a 6/10 experience overall.
[zfind] How was Maldives / Malé in general? I need to get there to tick it off.
[zfind] Countries I want to get to?
If that’s what you’re asking, in order of priority and doability:
Philippines
Sri Lanka with Maldives side trip
Oman.
Euro microstates
Ukraine
[movieman] @zfind: Oman was great.
Maldives was awesome on the local islands, if you're into diving / snorkeling.
Philippines also great once you get away from Manila. Highlights include Palawan, Bohol, the islands around Cebu.
[dinglejerry] I spent 11 days on a boat surfing so I only had a limited view of the rest . The water was absolutely stunning and so clean. Dolphins, turtles and fish swimming with us in the waves pretty regularly. Once I got away from Male we had waves all to ourselves fairly often.
People seemed really lovely too.
[illumination] Once I got away from Male
Was female any better?
[dinglejerry] @illumination: The collective trash ratio on Ozbargain is higher than normal at the moment
[zfind] Sounds heavenly aside from the boat part 😊 definitely on my list. Thank you!
[Disabled-User] Yes, you will get a succulent meal, a succulent Cantonese Chinese meal
[awkwardmon] i dont see where to enter in the promo code
[FujinShu] Food was fine tbh, service was standard, but KLIA (especially the international hub) doesn’t have much to do and wifi coverage over the terminal sucks a lot.
Good airline tho if it’s the cheapest you can find your route for.
[zfind] Worth noting that KLIA2 / low cost terminal is way better than the OG KLIA, so many food options and much more modern.
[Saints] KLIA 2 is a shit hole. The original Terminal is still a bliss even though its older.
KLIA 2 is a mall first then an airport. Its a dirty old strip mall catering to low cost carriers.
One of the most inefficient terminals ive ever seen. Changi
[ruprectaus] One of the most inefficient terminals ive ever seen.
I see you've not been to Manila (NAIA)?
[dinglejerry] I was surprised at this as well for a major international hub I would’ve expected a little bit better. I’m a vegetarian and flew with Malaysia airlines and struggled to find options in arrivals.
[zfind] KLIA is old, it’s been a busy hub for so long and it seems they haven’t invested a lot in the original build but rather went nuts on KLIA2, likely with the massive growth of AirAsia. The existing part needs a major overhaul especially with Changi as such a close alternative (though not as cheap to fly through).
[mmrazz] There's no change fee, but you do have to pay the fare difference.
I booked a trip with a similar discount code a few months ago. At one point after booking I was considering changing dates, so I looked at what it would cost, and it was about 10% extra - not because the fare had gone up, but because it failed to give the 10% discount when rebooking. In the end I decided not to change flights, and it's possible that if I'd called they would have given then 10% off - but at least based on the website it means that even changing to a "same price" fare will cost you an extra 10%!!
[justcallmeboss] Flew with them for the first time since 2014, earlier this year. Used to travel on them heaps before.
Outstanding product, A330neo's if you're travelling from Sydney, honestly, they were on par if not better than Thai Airways for international routes.
Also flew them domestically in Malaysia, FireFly (MAS' low cost arm) was surprisingly better, but both were great. Their 737's are obviously dated vs the A330neos so YMMV.
Would totally fly MAS again, sad I missed out on them for the past 12 years.
[Sammyboy] Perhaps they had friend/s or family member/s on one of the flights. Would that be irrational then?
[illumination] @Sammyboy:
Perhaps they had friend/s or family member/s on one of the flights. Would that be irrational then?
First things first, not sure if you realised but it the person who answered is the same person who said they had "missed out on them for the past 12 years"
Secondly, I'd say, yes it absolutely would still be irrational, but it would also be way more understandable despite being irrational
Why? Well, because "just because it happened to your family member, it doesn't mean it'll happen to you and flying is still the safest form of transport etc,"
But on the other hand, I would find it extremely difficult to justify to someone who suddenly "irrationally" thinks flying is inherently dangerous, precisely because, of all the people in this world it could've happened to, it was one of their loved ones.
I'd personally just concede that.. hey, I don't blame you for feeling that way, because despite how rational I think I am, I don't think I'd be capable of being rational if I were in their shoes.
[Frozensage] I find it cheaper flying to KL via Singapore than Malaysia Air. Why is that?
[illumination] Aviation logic
Cheaper to fly you indirect because the alternative for the airline could've been to fly empty and earn 0 revenue
AI could probably give you a pretty good answer actually
[m00seTheC0wSnake] Booking flights now but don’t see where there is a place to enter the code. Anyone able to do this successfully?
[Flintz] Their standard ticket already includes 1 date change and is only an extra $10 on top of the lite ticket. The flex fare is an extra $99. IMO the standard is enough for a single date change
[Zapwap] Flew a couple times and my experience was not so good Malaysian. Below average aircrafts and premium eco/economy seats are horrible. Staff was good though but comfort wise, for long haul flights I'd stay away from Malaysian.
[illumination] What are you comparing them to though? I think it ultimately depends on your benchmark, and whether you're factoring in price
[runamuck] Please be advised to use a credit card with no overseas transaction fees. Was charged overseas transaction fee even though it was paid in AUD.
[illumination] Please be advised to use a credit card with no overseas transaction fees
Not necessarily the best advice if doing so would result in missing out on Travel Insurance due to not meeting activation eligibility. It would arguably be worth copping the fee even on a AUD transaction (as annoying/stupid as it sounds) if that gets you Travel Insurance.
I would say it's more just "something to be aware of"
[h3blade] Never flying this airline again! They held up our group over a non-existent requirement for a stamped Sri Lanka visa, after proof unnecessary, they suddenly demanded credit cards from everyone. but most people doesn't have one and group leader have to proof enough deposit for entire group return ticket
Because of their foolishness, our entire group missed the flight with only 30 minutes left on the clock."
then
Customs even had to intervene to ask why we were being held up. and eventually we missed the boarding time and of course they said we gave you 30 mins to spare . therefore tickets are no fundable.
we have to buy another airline afterwards
